title: Free Course for Endurance Coaches: How to Scale Without Losing the Personal Touch

description: A free 5-day email course for running, triathlon and cycling coaches. Learn the 5 mistakes that cap your roster and how to fix them with simple AI workflows.
coverImageAlt: The course signup card: “Become an Irreplaceable Endurance Coach in 5 Days”, a free 5-day email course on the 5 biggest mistakes coaches make while scaling, and how to solve them using AI
bodyHtml:
The Irreplaceable Endurance Coach’s System is a free 5-day email course for running, triathlon and cycling coaches. It covers the 5 most common mistakes that cap how many athletes a coach can coach well, and how to fix each one, including with simple AI workflows.

It takes about 5 minutes a day. Sign up for free here.

On this page

  • Why endurance coaching is changing
  • Why it gets harder as your roster grows
  • What you’ll learn in the 5-day course
  • How the course uses AI (without AI coaching your athletes)
  • Is this course for me?
  • Frequently asked questions
  • Sign up for free

Why endurance coaching is changing

In the past, the training plan was the product. Coaches could keep communication light and athletes would still stay, as long as the plan was better than a standard PDF.

Now athletes can get a training plan anywhere. They can connect Strava to Claude. They can pay $18 a month for Runna. There are a million alternatives.

So athletes who hire a coach today aren’t paying for a plan (only). They want a coach who knows them, and knows them well.

Why it gets harder as your roster grows

At 8 athletes, you remember who has a sore knee, who is sleeping badly and who has a work trip next week. At 25, those details are spread across WhatsApp, email, phone calls, your training platform and your own memory.

That’s when things slip. You catch the missed workout but not the three nights of bad sleep behind it. An athlete says “I told you about my knee last week.” Slowly, your coaching starts to look like the $18 plan you’re supposed to be better than.

This course is about keeping your coaching personal as your roster grows.

What you’ll learn in the 5-day course

Each day covers one mistake coaches make as they grow, why it happens, and simple steps to fix it this week.

Day 1: Treating every piece of athlete information as a separate task

How to stop losing athlete details across WhatsApp, email, your training platform and your memory, so you see the whole picture before you adjust a plan.

Day 2: Letting scale turn individualized coaching into templated coaching

A 3-step way to review your whole roster in minutes, spot which athletes need you first, and keep every plan built around that athlete’s real constraints.

Day 3: Mistaking contact for communication

Why a weekly “how did it go?” doesn’t build trust, and 3 simple ways to get athletes to share what you actually need to know.

Day 4: Hiring around a broken process

How to know if you’re ready to hire an assistant coach, and what to fix first so new help adds capacity instead of cost.

Day 5: Training athletes without showing them their progress

How to build a simple monthly progress report, so athletes always know why they pay for a coach.

How the course uses AI (without AI coaching your athletes)

Every email ends with one AI workflow you can try the same day, using Claude or ChatGPT. You don’t need to be a tech person. On day 0 you set up one simple project in 10 minutes, and every workflow after that builds on it.

To be clear, this is not a course about handing your coaching to AI. You still make every coaching decision. AI does the sorting, searching and summarizing you do by hand today, like:

  • Summarizing an athlete’s week from notes, messages and training screenshots
  • Ranking your roster by who needs your attention first
  • Drafting check-in messages in your own voice
  • Writing a one-page athlete brief for an assistant coach
  • Turning your weekly notes into a monthly progress report

Is this course for me?

This course is for you if:

  • You coach enough athletes that you can’t hold every detail in your head anymore
  • You’re piecing together WhatsApp, email, phone calls and a training platform just to stay on top of one athlete
  • You’ve thought about hiring an assistant coach just to keep up
  • You want to grow your roster without your coaching starting to feel templated
  • You want to deliver the highest possible quality of coaching, at scale

Frequently asked questions

Is the course really free?

Yes. The Irreplaceable Endurance Coach’s System is completely free. You sign up with your email and get one lesson a day for 5 days.

How long does it take?

About 5 minutes a day to read each email. The optional AI workflows take a few more minutes, and you can try them the same day.

Who is the course for?

Running, triathlon and cycling coaches who coach more athletes than they can keep track of in their head, and who want to grow their roster without losing the personal touch.

Do I need to be good with technology or AI?

No. Every AI workflow is written for coaches who have never used AI before. You only need a free Claude or ChatGPT account.

Will AI coach my athletes?

No. The course is about using AI to organize and summarize athlete information. You still make every coaching decision.

How do I scale my coaching business without losing quality?

Start by getting all athlete information into one place, review your roster by who needs you most instead of in the same order every week, and fix your process before you hire. The course walks through each step.

Who made this course?

The course was made by augo, a coaching platform that brings every athlete’s conversations, workout data and feedback into one place for endurance coaches.

Sign up for free

Your athletes can get a training plan anywhere. What they can’t get from an app is a coach who really knows them. This course shows you how to keep it that way as you grow.

It’s free and takes about 5 minutes a day.
